sources.title: How to Predict Biomolecular Structures Using the OpenFold3 NIM
sources.snippet: OpenFold3 brings production-ready protein AI into the NVIDIA ecosystem, allowing for the modeling of multi-chain complexes, nucleic acids, and small-molecule ligands. The model delivers unprecedented speed, scale, and privacy-preserving collaboration for biopharma and biotech teams worldwide, thanks to NVIDIA cuEquivariance, MMseqs2-GPU, and NVIDIA FLARE. sources.snippet: OpenFold3-preview is a biomolecular structure prediction model aiming to be a bitwise reproduction of DeepMind's AlphaFold3, developed by the AlQuraishi Lab at Columbia University and the OpenFold consortium. This research preview is intended to gather community feedback and allow developers to start building on top of the OpenFold ecosystem.
